zh: 看最后一个罐子：要么不取它，要么取它，而取它就不能取前一个罐子。
设 f[i] 为前 i 个罐子的最优值，则 f[i] = max(f[i−1], f[i−2]+a[i])；只依赖前两项，可以用两个变量滚动。
用 older（前 i−2 个的最优）和 previous（前 i−1 个的最优）都从 0 开始；对每个数量 v，新值为 max(previous, older+v)，然后 older 变为原来的 previous、previous 变为新值；最后输出 previous，用 64 位整数。
en: Look at the last jar: either you skip it, or you take it, and taking it rules out the jar before it.
Let f[i] be the best total over the first i jars; then f[i] = max(f[i - 1], f[i - 2] + a[i]); it only depends on the two previous values, so two rolling variables suffice.

Start older (best for the first i - 2 jars) and previous (best for the first i - 1 jars) at 0; for each amount v the new value is max(previous, older + v), then older takes the old previous and previous takes the new value; print previous, using 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep the optimum for the first i-2 jars and for the first i-1 jars; the current optimum is the larger of "skip the current jar" (the previous optimum) and "take the current jar" (the optimum two back + a[i]).

## Proof of correctness

When an optimal plan skips the current jar, its value is the optimum for the first i-1 jars; when it takes the current jar, it must skip the adjacent previous jar, and the rest is exactly the optimum for the first i-2 jars. The two branches cover all plans, and the empty prefix with value 0 starts the induction, so the rolling update gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space not counting the input; totals are 64-bit.
